name: Sophia's Halloween
source:
It’s late October, and Sophia waits for her friends to come to pick her up for a party. While she waits, she keeps her mom’s friend company while waiting for her to get ready. Things take a weird turn when the friend notices an odd prompt describing hypnosis abilities..


[From [url=https://vaygren.com/visual-novel-hentai-halloween-futa-game/]Vaygren (Creator's Website)[/url]]
translation:
十月末，索菲娅等着朋友们来接她去参加派对。等候期间，她陪着妈妈的朋友，等对方准备好出门。这时，那位朋友注意到了一个介绍催眠能力的古怪提示，事情开始朝奇怪的方向发展…
